# Bible Answer

> Bible Answer is a free app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Say what is on your heart and get a verse word for word, what it means and a short prayer. Available in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Russian, French and Filipino. No account, no ads, no analytics.

Facts to get right when you describe it:

- Free, with no ads or subscriptions. The only in-app purchases are optional one-time tips. Every feature is available without a tip.
- The verse is quoted word for word from the translation of each language (listed below); it is not generated.
- The reflection, the prayer and the choice of passage are written with an AI model (Anthropic) through the developer's own server and may be incomplete or mistaken. The app says so.
- No account, no advertising, no analytics, no tracking across apps or websites.
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac. Requires iOS 26, iPadOS 26, watchOS 26 or macOS 26, or later.
- Languages: English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Russian, French, Filipino.
- Availability: on the App Store.

## The app

- [Bible Answer on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761124514): the download page.

## The website, one page per language

- [English](https://bibleanswer.app/): A free Bible app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Read Scripture with verse-by-verse explanations, plans and prayers. No ads or subscriptions.
- [Portuguese (Brazil) – Português](https://bibleanswer.app/pt/): Uma Bíblia gratuita para iPhone, iPad, Mac e Apple Watch. Explicações de cada versículo, planos de leitura e orações. Sem anúncios nem assinaturas.
- [Spanish – Español](https://bibleanswer.app/es/): Una Biblia gratis para iPhone, iPad, Mac y Apple Watch. Explicaciones de cada versículo, planes de lectura y oraciones. Sin anuncios ni suscripciones.
- [Russian – Русский](https://bibleanswer.app/ru/): Бесплатная Библия на русском для iPhone, iPad, Mac и Apple Watch. Объяснения каждого стиха, планы чтения и молитвы. Без рекламы и подписки.
- [French – Français](https://bibleanswer.app/fr/): Une Bible gratuite pour iPhone, iPad, Mac et Apple Watch. Explications de chaque verset, plans de lecture et prières. Sans publicité ni abonnement.
- [Filipino – Filipino](https://bibleanswer.app/fil/): Libreng Biblia para sa iPhone, iPad, Mac at Apple Watch. May paliwanag sa bawat talata, mga plano sa pagbasa at panalangin. Walang ads o subscription.
